import subprocess

# Final verification
result = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "status", "--short"],
    capture_output=True, text=True
)
print("Git status:", result.stdout if result.stdout.strip() else "(clean)")

result = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "log", "--oneline", "base..HEAD"],
    capture_output=True, text=True
)
print("Commits:")
print(result.stdout)

# Verify each commit only changes semver.py
for commit in ["b1fb26b", "8c43ceb", "66d4c31"]:
    result = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "diff-tree", "--no-commit-id", "-r", "--name-only", commit],
        capture_output=True, text=True
    )
    print(f"{commit}: {result.stdout.strip()}")
